title.tr: Hasır çatılı küçük ahşap kamelya, çimenlik bahçe
title.en: Small timber gazebo with a thatched roof on a lawn

alt.tr: Çimenlik bahçede çit önünde duran küçük, hasır çatılı ahşap kamelya ve iki basamak; çimde sararmış yapraklar
alt.en: Small timber gazebo with a thatched roof on a lawn in front of a hedge, with two steps and yellowed leaves on the grass

caption.tr: Dört direkli kamelyanın zemini ahşap, çatısı sazdan. Önünde iki basamak var.
caption.en: The four-post gazebo has a timber floor and a thatched roof. Two steps lead up to it.
